# PaddleOCR v4 + OpenVINO Performance Testing Project

This is a Python project for testing OCR performance using PaddleOCR v4 with OpenVINO acceleration.

## Project Structure
- Main OCR performance testing application
- Command-line interface for single image or directory processing
- Environment isolation with one-click deployment
- Performance timing and text extraction to .txt files

## Development Guidelines
- Use Python 3.8+ for compatibility with PaddleOCR v4
- Implement proper error handling and logging
- Focus on performance measurement and optimization
- Support both Windows and Linux environments
